exercises.title: U5 听力·对话 Choosing a Major
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Olivia: Have you decided which major to choose, Liu Ming?
Liu Ming: I'm thinking about data science. I believe it will offer many jobs.
Olivia: That sounds smart. I'd really like to study robotics myself.
Liu Ming: Robotics? Why is that?
Olivia: I love building things, and I think it's the career of the future.
Liu Ming: But your parents worry a lot about which university you get into, right?
Olivia: Yes, they think a person's career might depend on it.
Liu Ming: Well, I think what you're good at matters more than the school's name.
exercises.translation_cn: Olivia 问刘明选好专业没;刘明想学数据科学,认为工作机会多;Olivia 想学机器人学,因为爱动手做东西、觉得这是未来职业;刘明提到 Olivia 父母担心进哪所大学;刘明认为擅长什么比学校名气更重要。

exercises.title: U5 听力·短文 What a Career Test Does
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: A career aptitude test can help you see which jobs may suit you.
You answer many questions about what you like and how you behave.
Your answers are turned into a code that shows your work personality.
The test then suggests careers based on that code and your experience.
But remember, the results are only meant for guidance, not for orders.
exercises.translation_cn: 职业能力测试能帮你看清哪些工作适合你;你回答许多关于喜好和行为的问题;答案被转成代表你职业性格的代码;测试再据此代码和你的经验推荐职业;但要记住,结果只是用于指导,不是命令。

questions.stem: What can a career aptitude test help you see?
options: How much money you will earn.

questions.stem: What kind of questions do you answer in the test?
options: Questions about what you like and how you behave.

questions.stem: What are your answers turned into?
options: A code showing your work personality.

questions.stem: What does the test use to suggest careers?
What should you remember about the results?
options: They are only meant for guidance.

exercises.title: U5 听力·对话 Before the Interview
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Kelly: I have a job interview tomorrow, and I'm so nervous.
Mr Lee: Don't worry. Have you done any research about the company?
Kelly: Yes, I read everything on their website last night.
Mr Lee: Good. And remember to bring your CV and a cover letter.
Kelly: I've printed them out already. What about my clothes?
Mr Lee: Wear something smart, and try to stay calm when you answer.
Kelly: Should I arrive early?
Mr Lee: Yes, leave home in good time so you are never late.
exercises.translation_cn: Kelly 明天有面试很紧张;李老师问她有没有调查公司;Kelly 说昨晚看了官网所有内容;李老师提醒带简历和求职信;Kelly 已打印好,问穿什么;李老师建议穿得体、回答时保持冷静;并建议提早出门、绝不迟到。

questions.stem: How does Kelly feel about the interview?
What did Kelly do to prepare?
options: She read everything on the company's website.
She asked a friend to go for her.

questions.stem: What does Mr Lee tell her to bring?
options: Her CV and a cover letter.

questions.stem: What advice does Mr Lee give about answering questions?
options: Say as little as she can.

questions.stem: Why should Kelly leave home in good time?

exercises.title: U5 听力·短文 Camp Helpers Wanted
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Our summer camp is looking for keen high school helpers next year.
Helpers will guide guests and join in many fun activities.
You should have a good level of English and strong teamwork skills.
A friendly attitude and good handwriting are also welcome.
If you are interested, please send your CV to our receptionist.

exercises.title: U5 听力·对话 Advice on a Career Plan
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Susan: I really don't know how to start planning my career.
Mr Wang: First, think about what you want to do and what you enjoy.
Susan: I love helping people, so maybe public health?
Mr Wang: That's a great start. Now think about the skills you'll need.
Susan: I guess I should improve my communication and teamwork.
Mr Wang: Exactly. And don't forget to prepare a good CV.
Susan: Should I tailor it for each job?
Mr Wang: Yes. A CV that matches the job will impress employers more.
exercises.translation_cn: Susan 不知如何开始规划职业;王老师建议先想想自己想做什么、喜欢什么;Susan 爱帮助别人,想到公共卫生;王老师说是好开端,要想需要的技能;Susan 想提升沟通和团队合作;王老师让她别忘准备好简历;Susan 问要不要为每份工作量身定做;王老师说要,匹配岗位的简历更能打动雇主。

questions.stem: What is Susan's problem at the start?

exercises.title: U5 听力·短文 Passion and Patience
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: The best careers often grow from a deep love for the work.
When you are passionate, hard work feels much less tiring.
Think of a young photographer who waits for hours to take one photo.
His patience and passion finally won him an award for his talent.
So follow what you love, and never give up too soon.
exercises.translation_cn: 最好的职业往往源于对工作的深深热爱;当你充满热情,辛苦的工作就不那么累;想想那位为拍一张照片等上数小时的年轻摄影师;他的耐心和热情最终为他赢得了表彰才华的奖项;所以追随你所热爱的,别太早放弃。
